contexts.text: Such are called thrust through. Illustrated.
The thrust through of Jehovah () = those who are vastated.

comment.comment:
#preserve 'thrust through' typically 'slain'; still can't find a home for this reference. @1070[4]. "The thrust through" = those who do not know what the truths of faith are.
#separator

contexts.text: The sons of Jacob came upon the thrust through (). Explained.
The thrust through, in the Word, = truths and goods extinguished. Illustrated.
The multitude of the thrust through () = that thence are innumerable falsities, and those who are in falsities.
The thrust through () = those with whom good and truth have been extinguished.
To be thrust through () = to perish from the evil of falsity.
As by one killed, or thrust through is signified the extinction of good and truth... Illustrated. AC 9262:3. AC 9262:4. AC 9262:5.
The thrust through of Jehovah = those who perish through falsities. AE 659:22.
The thrust through, in the Word, = those with whom truths have been extinguished through falsities. ( = those with whom the truths and goods of the Church have been extinguished. AE 304:20.)
The thrust through of Jehovah () = those with whom all the truths of the Church have been destroyed through falsities.
The thrust through = those with whom all truth has been extinguished. (Compare AE 315:18.)
Those are called thrust through who have perished by falsities. AE 391:26. AE 405:46. AE 518:29. AE 537:16. AE 659:7. AE 750:13.
The wounded () = those who spiritually perish by the deprivation of truth.
The thrust through = those with whom truths lave been extinguished.
The killed that are thrust through with the sword () = those who have perished by the falsities of evil.
The thrust through, in the Word, = those who perish by falsities; for the sword, with which they are thrust through, = falsity destroying truth.
The thrust through with the sword = in the Word, those who have extinguished truths with them-selves by means of falsities. AE 659:3. AE 811:14.
The thrust through with the sword = those who have been condemned to the Hells on account of falsities.
